history.summary: The Sangameswarar Temple stands at Kooduthurai in Bhavani, ~15 km northeast of Erode, at the confluence of the Kaveri, the Bhavani and the mystic Amutha (Agaya Gangai) rivers - the 'Dakshina Triveni Sangamam' (southern triveni), also called Thatchina Prayagai, Bhadrikasiramam and Mukkudal. Because the Lord is at the sangam (confluence) he is called Sangameswarar. This is the 261st Devara Paadal Petra Shiva Sthalam and the 3rd sthalam in Kongu Nadu, praised by Tirugnanasambandar as Thirunana; Arunagirinathar also composed Thirupugazh on Murugan here. Legend tells of Kubera, flying over the Cauvery, who saw a deer, tiger, cow, elephant, snake and rat drinking together without enmity under an ilandhai tree and was told by a voice from the sky to worship the shivalingam beneath it - the temple's ilandhai tree is said to fruit in all seasons and its fruit is used in daily puja. A famous colonial-era episode: Coimbatore Collector William Garo (Garrow) survived the 1802 collapse of his Travellers' bungalow after being lured out by a mysterious girl he took to be Goddess Vedanayaki, and presented her an ivory/golden cradle (oonjal) on 11-1-1804; three holes in the temple's outer wall through which he worshipped the goddess, and his signature on the cradle frame, are still pointed out. Uniquely, the Murugan shrine stands between the Swami and Amman shrines (hence 'Kanthamurthy'). Devotees perform last rites for ancestors on the riverbank. The 5-tiered Dravidian raja gopuram faces north with two corridors; the koneru tanks are named Surya Theertham and Gayatri Theertham.

name: Bhavani Sangameswarar Temple (Thirukooduthurai)
town: Kooduthurai, Bhavani (CSV town 'Erode' is approximate - ~15 km NE of the city)
town_description: Bhavani is a municipal town in Erode district at the meeting point of the Kaveri and Bhavani rivers, about 15 km northeast of Erode. One of the oldest pilgrimage centres of Kongu Nadu, its life revolves around the riverside Sangameswarar temple, with the town, the temple goddess and the river all sharing the name Bhavani.
